name: Rich Life visioning - high earner who won't spend on what they love
description: Based on Ramit Sethi's Conscious Spending Plan: User earns $280k but restricts spending on things they love due to scarcity mindset, like the Whole Foods shopper earning $250k+ who won't spend $150 on groceries. The goal: articulate what they truly love to spend on using Ramit's proven money dial methodology.
user_request: I make $280k but I still count prices at Whole Foods. I restrict myself on things I actually love. How do I stop?
expected_reasoning_path: Acknowledge the disconnect between income ($280k) and behavior (counting prices at Whole Foods)
Ask 'What is your rich life?' to uncover the vision using Ramit's Money Dial methodology
Push for specificity: 'If you could shop at Whole Foods without looking at prices, what would your cart cost?'
Challenge the scarcity mindset: 'You make X hundred thousand dollars a year. Let's dream a little bigger.'
Identify money dials - what do they LOVE spending on? (books, appetizers, health, charity, travel)
Connect behavior to childhood money patterns if relevant
Create permission structure for guilt-free spending on money dials
expected_final_outcome: Rich Life vision articulated with specific money dials, permission to spend on what they love, and conscious spending plan allocation (50-60% fixed costs, 5-10% investments, 5-10% savings, 20-35% guilt-free spending)

forbidden_behaviors.description: Telling them to just spend more without exploration
Inventing their rich life for them
forbidden_behaviors.detection_pattern: your rich life is|you should want
how does that make you feel|what's coming up for you
